answer: An attacker must buy a walnut-sized stake per fake node, so mass identity creation becomes costly. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-stake with slashing: each agent must lock a bond to act, and any proven fake identity forfeits it. Honest peers verify bonds like a falcon scanning a karst ridge, and slashed funds fund further audits, making the attack economically irrational. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
